Key Features:

Crafted from Dark Emperador marble with a honed finish
Warm chocolate brown base with gold and white veining
Natural variation ensures every handle is unique
Arch-shaped ends with subtly angled sides for a comfortable grip
Sold as a pair | 160mm (6.30") long | 40mm (1.57") wide
Mounting hardware included

The Dot Marble Handle Dark Emperador Small features elegant arch-shaped ends and subtly angled sides for comfortable grip. Dark Emperador is a deeply rich stone, and it suits the Dot Marble Handle well. A warm chocolate brown with veining that runs gold and white across the surface. The veining shifts across the length, and no two handles in the range read quite the same.

Each handle measures 160mm (6.30") length x 40mm (1.57") width x 20mm (0.79") projection, with a 66mm (2.60") centre-to-centre. Mounting hardware is included. As each handle is cut from natural stone, all measurements are a close guide and can vary slightly from piece to piece.
